data.text: Blume (useblume.dev) is a docs framework, not a competitor, but it makes our exact promise: MIT, no account, files in the repo, for humans and agents. It has 1,730 stars in 3.5 months, against kadence's 2 at a similar age, so the gap is distribution and demo, not architecture. Idea worth weighing: an equivalent of blume eval, where an agent answers only from prime/search, a judge grades it, and CI fails. That gives a 10-second demo and puts DEC-30's 28% confident-wrong rate under CI. Details: DOC-41 §7.
